verdict.rationale: Token2 keys are documented as FIDO2/WebAuthn authenticators that work in standard browsers. The only major service with specific integration evidence is Microsoft: Entra ID key registration and Intune passwordless workstation login. Missing for 10: any evidence of use with Google, GitHub, or password managers; explicit U2F (CTAP1) support; independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-service compatibility.

support.subject: As a power user, the key works as a WebAuthn/U2F second factor across the major services I already use — Google, GitHub, Microsoft, password managers

citations.quote: This tool streamlines the process of registering FIDO2 security keys in Microsoft Entra ID by leveraging the FIDO2 Provisioning Graph API.
Register a security key or passkey, then log in with it — all in your browser using the WebAuthn API.
No special tool installation is needed to start using the FIDO keys, as most modern browsers will prompt to set a PIN when required
